feature: Cache MarkdownUI Theme to prevent rebuild on every body evaluation
workflow_rationale: The fix was already applied in commit 82ead44 as part of a comprehensive audit. The chatTheme computed property has been replaced with @State cachedTheme + onChange(of: theme.id) caching. This task requires only verifying the fix is correct and both iOS/macOS builds succeed.

phases.name: Verification
phases.description: Verify the existing fix is correct and complete, then confirm both iOS and macOS builds succeed. The primary fix (caching MarkdownUI.Theme via @State) is already applied in commit 82ead44.

subtasks.description: Verify MarkdownTextView.swift has no chatTheme computed property. Confirm @State cachedTheme, @State cachedThemeId, and onChange(of: theme.id, initial: true) are all present. The fix should prevent theme rebuild on every SwiftUI body evaluation — only calling buildChatTheme(from:) when theme.id actually changes.

verification.expected: Shows cachedTheme, cachedThemeId, and onChange — no 'var chatTheme' computed property

subtasks.notes: Verification passed. MarkdownTextView.swift already has the correct implementation: @State cachedTheme, @State cachedThemeId, and onChange(of: theme.id, initial: true). No chatTheme computed property exists. The fix prevents theme rebuild on every SwiftUI body evaluation.

subtasks.description: Run iOS build to confirm the caching fix compiles correctly and there are no regressions.
subtasks.notes: iOS build succeeded. xcodebuild -scheme ILSApp completed with ** BUILD SUCCEEDED **. The MarkdownUI theme caching fix (cachedTheme + onChange(of: theme.id, initial: true)) compiles correctly with no errors.

subtasks.description: Run macOS build to confirm the caching fix compiles correctly and there are no regressions.
subtasks.notes: macOS build succeeded with ** BUILD SUCCEEDED ** - caching fix compiles correctly with no regressions
